##### Position Overview

At Okta, we are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and analytical **Senior Payroll Analyst** to join our Americas Payroll team. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing accurate, compliant, and timely semi-monthly payroll operations across multi-state US jurisdictions for over 5,000+ employees, with opportunities to support broader AMER entities (e.g., Canada, Argentina, Mexico and Uruguay).

As a subject matter expert in payroll processing, multi-state tax compliance, and benefit/equity reconciliations, you will drive operational excellence, implement workflow automations, and deliver white-glove support to our growing employee base.

##### What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

- **End-to-End Payroll Operations:** Own and execute complex bi-weekly multi-state US payroll cycles, ensuring accurate calculations for base salary, variable compensation (sales commissions, bonuses), retro adjustments, and termination payouts.
- **Equity & Off-Cycle Administration:** Partner closely with Stock Administration and Accounting to process and reconcile equity-related transactions (RSUs, ESPP, NQSOs) and manage off-cycle payroll runs.
- **Benefits, Deductions & Garnishments:** Oversee compliance and execution of specialized deductions, including 401(k) contributions/match audits, FSA/HSA, wage garnishments, and taxable fringe benefits.
- **Tax & Statutory Compliance:** Ensure strict adherence to federal, state, and local payroll tax regulations. Manage multi-state tax setups, resolve tax agency notices, and support year-end W-2 reconciliation and reporting.
- **Internal Controls & Audits:** Execute rigorous pre- and post-payroll audit procedures in compliance with SOX controls, internal accounting policies, and external financial audit requirements.
- **Process Automation & Efficiency:** Identify opportunities to optimize workflows; develop and maintain automated reporting and reconciliation models using advanced Excel and data tools (e.g., Alteryx, Workday EIBs).
- **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Support:** Serve as a Tier-2 escalation point for employee inquiries submitted via ServiceNow. Collaborate cross-functionally with People Operations, Total Rewards, HR Business Partners, and Corporate Accounting.

##### What You’ll Bring (Qualifications & Experience)

- **Experience:** 5+ years of progressive, end-to-end multi-state US payroll experience, ideally within a high-growth SaaS, tech, or large public enterprise environment.
- **Technical & System Expertise:**
  - Advanced proficiency with **Workday Payroll** and **Workday HCM**.
  - Deep experience with payroll vendor reporting tools, ticketing systems (e.g., **ServiceNow**), and time-tracking systems.
  - Advanced **Excel skills** (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested logic, pivot tables). Experience with **Alteryx** or other automation tools is a strong plus.
- **Payroll & Tax Knowledge:** In-depth understanding of US labor laws, FLSA classifications, multi-state withholding, reciprocal agreements, and payroll accounting principles (GL mapping, accruals, account reconciliations).
- **Problem Solving & Autonomy:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to independently investigate payroll discrepancies, reconcile large datasets, and handle ambiguous scenarios.
- **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to clearly explain complex compensation and tax matters to employees and leadership.
- **Certifications:** Certified Payroll Professional (**CPP**) or equivalent payroll accreditation is preferred.

##### Why Join Okta’s Americas Payroll Team?

- Be part of a collaborative, high-impact finance and accounting organization that values innovation, automation, and continuous learning.
- Enjoy competitive total compensation, comprehensive health and retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching and ESPP), and flexible remote work flexibility.
